name: xTool P3
notes: CO2 laser with an optional 5 W infrared laser module (and an inkjet printer head). With the 5 W module fitted, the CO2 area is 670 x 458.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension ZY015 (exts/P3), read 2026-11-26. Work areas from processingArea (915 x 458; RED_LASER x 245..915, height 458 - 31; co2With5wArea 670 x 458); modules from defaultPower [80, 5, 0], the CO2 head and the Infrared laser module. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
